title.value: Human-Centered Responsible Artificial Intelligence: Current & Future Trends
title.justification: The title is clearly stated at the beginning of the paper and encapsulates the main focus and subject of discussion throughout the paper.
title.quote: Human-Centered Responsible Artificial Intelligence: Current & Future Trends

extractions.description: The paper focuses on the emerging trends in human-centered and responsible artificial intelligence. It aims to integrate human factors into the design and development of AI systems to ensure they align with human rights, ethics, and reduce potential harms. It discusses the growing interest in responsible AI within the community, the ethical considerations involved, and the need for future collaboration to advance this field.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on human-centered and ethical considerations in AI, rather than directly addressing climate or ecological sustainable development. The emphasis is on AI's impact on society, human rights, and ethics.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: all of this work is ultimately aimed at developing AI that benefits humanity while being grounded in human rights and ethics, and reducing the potential harms of AI.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not primarily focus on climate or ecological sustainable development but rather on ethical and human-centered approaches to AI, which fall outside the predefined categories.
primary_category.quote: Human-Centered Responsible Artificial Intelligence aims to bring people and their values into the design and development of AI systems, which can contribute to building systems that benefit people and societies, as well as preventing and mitigating potential harms.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper does not address any secondary climate or ecological sustainable development categories as its central theme is not related to these areas.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not fit within the specified sub-categories related to climate or ecological sustainable development, as its focus is on responsible and human-centered AI development.
primary_sub_category.quote: The SIG’s primary goal is to create a sense of community among researchers in this area, from academia and industry, to establish collaborations.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: Since the paper doesn't address any climate or ecological sustainable development themes, no secondary sub-categories are applicable.

applications.justification: There are no specific applications of AI towards climate or ecological sustainable development discussed in this paper.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper centers around the development of AI systems that are responsible, ethical, and human-centered, focusing on reducing harm and aligning with human rights.
new_primary_category.quote: Human-Centered Responsible Artificial Intelligence (HCR-AI) aims to bring people and their values into the design and development of AI systems, which can contribute to building systems that benefit people and societies, as well as preventing and mitigating potential harms.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The focus on integrating human values and ethics into AI system design justifies this new sub-category.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Aligned with responsible AI are calls to make AI more human-centric. In particular, there is an emphasis on the challenges of AI integration into socio-technical processes to preserve human autonomy and control.
